北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，注意保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has haze. Remember to wear a mask and keep warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪雾大，路滑能见度低，出行请慢行，注意安全哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is very foggy, roads are slippery and visibility is low. Please travel slowly and stay safe!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光明媚，气温 7℃。出门记得添衣，享受舒适好天气！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is bright and sunny, 7℃. Remember to add clothes and enjoy the comfortable weather!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光普照，气温 12℃。湿度高，穿衣注意通风，保持舒爽！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is bright and sunny, 12℃. High humidity, wear breathable clothes to stay comfortable!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光暖暖，气温 16℃。天气舒服，别忘了防晒，多喝水哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is warm and sunny, 16℃. The weather is comfortable, don't forget sun protection and drink more water!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，气温 8℃。体感有点凉，记得多穿件外套，暖暖的！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is bright and sunny, 8℃. It feels a bit cool, remember to wear an extra jacket to stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，气温 5℃。体感偏凉，多穿点，小心别感冒了！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, 5℃. It feels quite cool, wear more clothes, be careful not to catch a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 10℃，早晚温差大。注意添减衣物，保持好心情哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy at 10℃, with a big temperature difference between morning and evening. Pay attention to adding or removing clothes, and keep a good mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉雾气蒙蒙，气温 3℃。路面湿滑，能见度低，出行注意安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, 3℃. Roads are slippery and visibility is low, travel safely!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阳光好，气温 3℃，体感有点冷。多穿几层，暖和最重要！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and 3℃, but feels a bit cold. Layer up, staying warm is key!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云 12℃，体感稍凉。早晚温差大，记得多添衣保暖哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy at 12℃, feeling a bit cool. There's a big temperature difference between morning and evening, remember to add clothes to keep warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨雾气大，气温 -7℃，非常冷！务必穿厚点，小心地滑哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is very foggy, -7℃, very cold! Be sure to dress warmly and watch out for slippery surfaces!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有雾 2℃，体感偏冷。出行慢行，注意防滑，也要保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is foggy at 2℃, feels cold. Travel slowly, watch out for slippery surfaces, and also keep warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，气温 10℃。体感舒适，早晚记得添衣，别着凉！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is bright and sunny, 10℃. It feels comfortable, remember to add clothes in the morning and evening, don't catch a cold!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光正好，气温 14℃。天气温暖，适合户外活动，心情美美！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and 14℃. The weather is warm, suitable for outdoor activities, enjoy yourself!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阳光正好，气温 8℃。风力有点大，出门记得防风保暖哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny and 8℃. The wind is a bit strong, remember to protect against wind and keep warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，气温 5℃，风力较大。注意防护，戴好口罩多保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has haze, 5℃, and strong wind. Pay attention to protection, wear a mask and keep warm!
